newsitem.title: BELARUS: SOCCER-SCOTLAND'S CUP CAMPAIGN HIT BY INJURIES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SCOTLAND'S CUP CAMPAIGN HIT BY INJURIES.

text.p: Scotland's World Cup campaign has suffered a setback ahead of Sunday's qualifier against Belarus with several players out of action due to injury.

Monaco midfielder John Collins and Queens Park Rangers striker John Spencer are the latest casualties. Collins has a back problem and Spencer a hamstring strain, forcing both to miss the trip to Minsk.
In all, Scotland are missing 12 players who have so far featured in their campaign for next year's finals in France.
Scotland head group four ahead of Austria and Sweden.

Belarus will be missing Sheffield Wednesday striker Pyotr Kachuro who has been forced to sit out the match after getting his second yellow card in Belarus's last outing, a 2-0 defeat to Latvia in April.

Belarus - Valery Shantolosov; Sergei Gurenko, Erik Yakhimovich, Sergei Shtanyuk, Andrei Ostrovsky; Vladimir Zhuravel, Sergei Gerasimets, Valentin Belkevich, Radislav Orlovsky; Vladimir Makovsky, Andrei Khlebosolov.
Scotland - Jim Leighton; Tom Boyd, Craig Burley, Jackie McNamara, Tosh McKinlay; Paul Lambert, Scott Gemmill, Gary McAllister, Kevin Gallacher; Darren Jackson, Gordon Durie.
